text:
anika: Heads-up — HF -> Redwood conversion for model 'llama-mini-4b' dropped tokenizer.json; only tokenizer_config.json present. Serving is falling back to slow tokenizer and we see special-token mapping issues. Anyone hit this?

ben: saw the same on my eval job. grep shows `special_tokens_map` inside tokenizer_config.json but there's no tokenizer.json or vocab/merges. :eyes:

carmen: how is it failing in runtime? stack?

ben: Runtime log snippet:
```
RuntimeError: TokenizerLoadError: no fast tokenizer files found for ./models/llama-mini-4b
Falling back to slow tokenizer loader
Warning: special_tokens_map not found in slow tokenizer -> decode/pad mismatch
```

samir: workaround that worked locally: run the HF tokenizer save flow to materialize tokenizer.json + vocab/merges.
`python -c "from transformers import AutoTokenizer; t=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('./model'); t.save_pretrained('./model')"`
After that runtime picked up the fast tokenizer and prefix tokens aligned.

anika: did that also fix chat templates/specials? we saw `<bos>` getting remapped and EM dropped on SQuAD-like eval.

ben: yes, EM went up ~1.8% after syncing special_tokens_map in both files. I put a small converter at `tools/hf_tokenizer_sync.py` to copy and normalize fields.

ci-bot: created CI job `tokenizer-sync-check` and ran it on PR #456 — it now fails if tokenizer.json missing or if specials differ.

carmen: plan: add a preflight in onboarding pipeline: (1) require tokenizer.json present, (2) validate `special_tokens_map` equality between tokenizer.json and tokenizer_config.json, (3) fail fast with actionable message. I'll open the PR.

samir: also adding a runtime shim: if fast tokenizer missing, emit explicit error and refuse to serve until conversion done. Silent slow fallback caused the regression.

anika: perfect. tagging @devex to update the onboarding doc and conversion notes. Thanks all! :white_check_mark:
